resources.string: Watches text fields for shorthands you define (for example cool/) and replaces them with their full text as you type. Text is only read to find your triggers and is never stored or sent anywhere.
Accessibility service is ON – shorthands expand in other apps.
Accessibility service is OFF – shorthands will not expand until it is turned on.
Placeholders: {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {cursor}. Triggers fire after a space, punctuation or at the start of a line.
No shorthands yet. Tap “Add shorthand” to create one.
That is really cool, thanks for sharing!
Replace your %1$d shorthand(s) with the %2$d from the file, or merge them?
Imported %1$d shorthand(s). Undo last import in the menu puts your previous list back.
Your current shorthands could not be kept before the import. Import anyway?
Put back the %1$d shorthand(s) you had before your last import? This replaces your current %2$d shorthand(s).
Put back the %1$d shorthand(s) you had before your last import.
No shorthands were found in that file.
Your saved shorthands could not be read. They were kept aside unchanged, and the list started empty.
Your saved shorthands could not be read, and a copy could not be made. They were left unchanged, and nothing will be saved over them until a copy can be made.
Not saved. Your earlier shorthands could not be read or copied aside, so they were left as they are.
